reconcile.note: Gill distinguishes sanctioned joy at the fall of God's public enemies, as in Psalm 58:10, from the private gloating over a personal enemy's ruin that Proverbs 24:17 forbids.

sides.snippet: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance.
sides.verseText: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

sides.snippet: Don't rejoice when your enemy falls.
sides.verseText: Don't rejoice when your enemy falls. Don't let your heart be glad when he is overthrown;
